title: The accused gets to answer, at length
text: The accused gets to answer, at length (seen 1003, 1020, 1120, 167). Why: fairness, and legal safety. Weakened: the accused's answer is often short or missing (1003, 1112, EP.162). Narrowed to a rule by HKS-C21.
